summary.text: Linda Garcia is a Democratic state representative from Texas who has represented District 107 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Garcia, who is also known as Luz, lists her profession as community advocate.

paragraphs.text: Linda Garcia, also known as Luz, assumed office in the Texas House on January 14, 2025, succeeding Victoria Neave Criado, a Democrat.
Her career experience includes working as a community advocate.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for District 107 on March 3, 2026.
